timeline.summary: 22 Apr 2026: Beta Drugs said its plant was inspected by Azerbaijan's Ministry of Health (13-17 Apr) with GMP approval expected in one to two months, and that it received Philippines CPRs for 2 brands, both first generics there.
Allotted 2.83 lakh equity shares at ₹1,712.49 per share for the acquisition of Nivian Lifesciences Private Limited.
Beta Drugs reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹396.0 Cr (+7.4% YoY) and PAT of ₹41.5 Cr; impacted by CCD interest costs.
Beta Drugs reported utilization of ₹23.27 Cr from its ₹117 Cr preferential issue as of March 2026, with ₹93.7 Cr remaining in fixed deposits.
Beta Drugs presented its FY26 performance, highlighting dermatology break-even and a target of 80% high-margin revenue by 2030.
In its Q4FY26 concall, Beta Drugs guided for 20-25% annual revenue growth and 23-24% EBITDA margins for FY27, with Vision 2030 revenue targeted at ₹850-900 Cr.
Beta Drugs completed the acquisition of a 66.09% stake in Nivian Lifesciences Private Limited on May 22, 2026.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹137.49 Cr, net profit ₹19.28 Cr.
Beta Drugs reported H1FY27 revenue growth of 29% to ₹263 Cr with EBITDA margins expanding to 23.2%.
Beta Drugs Limited uploaded audio recording of earnings conference call held on 22 October 2026.
Beta Drugs hosted its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call on October 22, 2026, reporting strong operational and financial progress.
